text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives Gambia's president, Yahya Jammeh, who arrived in Kuwait on Monday.
- Egyptian delegation due in Kuwait on Tuesday to discuss the establishment of a joint free-trade zone.
- Some parliamentarians insist on holding a sit-in on Tuesday inside the parliament building to protest against Israeli policies in Jerusalem.
- MP says Kuwait does not hold any Iraqi prisoners of war. Kuwait accuses Baghdad of detaining some 600 people, mainly Kuwaitis, missing since the 1990-91 Iraqi occupation of the Gulf Arabs state.

- Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah received in London Qatar's Prime Minister and Interior Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Khalifa al-Thani. Sheikh Saad flew to Britain last month following a colon surgery in Kuwait.
- New Ministry of Social Affairs and Labour panel to monitor any violations by private sector employers.
- Indian oil worker wounded in mine explosion.
